info.name: ATHENA Platform API
info.description:
Production REST API for the ATHENA Decision Intelligence Platform — a single-user, advisory-only NSE/BSE swing-trading system. ATHENA never places or executes trades; this API is read/inspect/annotate only (journal entries and manually-logged fills are the sole write paths that touch the owner's own record-keeping, never a broker order).

Every endpoint requires authentication (Bearer access token from /api/v1/auth/login) except /api/v1/auth/login itself, /api/v1/auth/status, and the platform health/discovery endpoints. Errors follow RFC 7807 Problem Details. Collection endpoints share one envelope: {status, data, meta, pagination}.

Owner-requested (2026-07-29): "kill everything and restart fresh" —
the only reliable way to end a genuinely stuck background job (a
Python thread cannot be force-killed in isolation) is to end the whole
process. Relaunches with the exact flags this process itself was
started with (RestartUnavailableError/501 if that isn't known, e.g.
a ServeRuntime not started via the CLI). The process exits shortly
after this response is sent — expect the connection to drop.
